title: Trade intent (the trader's proposal, cr.trade-intent.v3)
description: One trade proposal from the trader agent (Junior Trader Desk invariant 1, Eric 2026-10-27; pipeline review). cr.trade-intent.v2 with the ticket it acts on (D8, Eric 2026-10-28): the desk project, the ticket receipt and Eric's PM decision, whose grant the Paper Book reads from the desk's own record of his decisions (projects/<project_id>/tickets/decisions.jsonl) and never takes from its caller. thesis_id equals receipt_id, which a JSON Schema cannot state; the engine refuses an intent where they differ. The agent is an analyst only: it never sets a client order ID, a quantity or an amount the desk did not grant. core/trade-risk.js (cr-trade-risk@2) checks every intent against the hard limits and is the authority; this schema documents the shape. Every price and amount is a plain decimal string, read exactly and never through a binary float. cr.trade-intent.v2 stays as published, and the engine no longer accepts it. This file is never edited: a change is cr.trade-intent.v4.

intent_id.description: A ULID, one per intent: the engine's idempotency key, from which it derives the client order ID.

thesis_id.description: The ticket receipt: equal to receipt_id.

project_id.description: The desk project whose ticket this acts on.

decision_id.description: Eric's PM decision (td_…) on that receipt. It grants risk only while it is the decision in force for the receipt and an approve or a halve above $0.

pair.description: Exactly as the allowlist names it.

side.description: Long only. A CLOSE_LONG closes the whole open quantity of position_id and reads no grant.

position_id.description: Only for CLOSE_LONG: the open Paper Book position it closes.

reference_price.description: The price the intent was written against.

risk_ceiling_usd.description: The most the trade may lose at its stop, every cost in. Checked against the hard limits and the grant of the decision it names, never adopted.

valid_until.description: Read as the earlier of itself and created_at plus the engine's longest validity.

evidence.description: Kept with the intent for the record; the engine reads none of it for a decision.
